The '''2024 Retro League Event 1''' was the first event of the [[2024 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]] (28 January – 13 March 2024), played in [[Premiere - Hoth]] format.<ref name="t84003" /> [[Timo Dusel]] won.<ref name="t84003" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 28 January – 13 March 2024
* '''Players:''' 76 (in the posted standings)
* '''Winner:''' [[Timo Dusel]]

== Final standings ==
